# TRANSCRIPT: RECORDER FOUND AT THE NORTH TREELINE [color=#5C6B58]Pinned and locked. Transcript only. The audio is not on this board and will not be.[/color]
### #1 treeline_patrol (OP) // 83.05.13 I do perimeter checks for the colony on the north side. Two days ago I found a camp about two hundred metres into the trees. Fire burned out, two sleeping bags, a cooking pot, one boot. A hand recorder on a log next to the fire, still running, battery nearly flat.
I handed the camp in to security. I made a copy of the recorder before I did. I have typed it out below. The two campers are A and B. I have left their names out. Times are from the recorder counter.
- [color=#93AE8B]00:00:04 A:[/color] Is it on? Hello? Hello? Okay. Night one at the north treeline. B is pretending he can build a fire. - [color=#93AE8B]00:00:15 B:[/color] I can build a fire. Hand me the, hand me the lighter, will you. - [color=#93AE8B]00:01:40 A:[/color] So we said we would get a recording of the calling thing for the board. This is us. Sitting here. Waiting for a ghost. - [color=#93AE8B]00:01:52 B:[/color] It is a bird. Write that down. It is a bird. - [color=#5C6B58]00:02:00 to 00:30:55 talking, eating, fire noise. Nothing unusual.[/color] - [color=#93AE8B]00:31:02 VOICE, a woman, faint, left of the fire:[/color] Dani? Dani, come in now, it is late. - [color=#93AE8B]00:31:10 A, whispering:[/color] That is my sister. That is my sister's voice. - [color=#93AE8B]00:31:14 B:[/color] Your sister is on the other side of the colony. - [color=#93AE8B]00:31:16 A:[/color] She says that every night. Exactly that. When she calls her kid in. - [color=#93AE8B]00:33:50 VOICE, the woman:[/color] Dani? Dani, come in now, it is late. - [color=#93AE8B]00:34:02 B:[/color] Right. I am going to go and look. - [color=#93AE8B]00:34:03 A:[/color] Do not. The rules say. - [color=#93AE8B]00:34:05 B:[/color] It is a bird. I will be two minutes. - [color=#5C6B58]00:34:10 footsteps going away, left. Branches.[/color] - [color=#5C6B58]00:34:20 to 00:36:10 fire noise only.[/color] - [color=#93AE8B]00:36:12 VOICE, B's voice, from the trees:[/color] I can build a fire. Hand me the, hand me the lighter, will you. - [color=#93AE8B]00:36:19 A, whispering:[/color] B? - [color=#93AE8B]00:36:24 A, louder:[/color] B, where are you? - [color=#93AE8B]00:37:45 VOICE, B's voice, closer:[/color] It is a bird. I will be two minutes. - [color=#5C6B58]00:37:52 something moves through the camp. The recorder is knocked, then still.[/color] - [color=#5C6B58]00:38:00 to 01:19:20 breathing, very close to the recorder. Slow, heavy, through the mouth. Forty one minutes of it.[/color] - [color=#93AE8B]01:19:31 VOICE, A's voice:[/color] Is it on? Hello? Hello? - [color=#5C6B58]01:19:36 recording ends. Battery.[/color]
### #2 sap_and_saw // 83.05.13 It knocked the recorder and then it sat next to it for forty minutes. Listening. To what? There was nobody left to listen to.
### #3 treeline_patrol (OP) // 83.05.13 To itself, maybe. Or it was waiting to see if anyone would come back to the fire. I have stopped trying to work out why.
### #4 audio_bench // 83.05.14 I work comms. treeline_patrol sent me the copy before posting, and I put the lines side by side on a console. The voice at 00:36:12 is not like B. It is B. The same breath before the word lighter, the same stumble on hand me the. At 01:19:31 it is A's opening line, with the same little crackle where A's thumb was on the microphone at 00:00:04. It is not copying a voice. It is playing back the exact moment it heard.
The woman's line at 00:31:02 and 00:33:50 is the same too. Identical. Which means it heard A's sister call her kid in, somewhere, at least once.
### #5 riverbank_kid // 83.05.14 Then it has been near the habs. Near the houses. Close enough to hear a mother at a door.
### #6 mynah_theory // 83.05.15 Why will the mods not post the audio? If it is real, people should hear it. People would take the rules seriously.
### #7 ember_keeper (mod) // 83.05.15 Two reasons. The first is A and B's families, who have heard it and asked us not to.
The second I will say as a rumour, because that is all it is. On another board, before this one, someone posted a recording like this and people played it on a loop to pick it apart. Some of them started hearing the lines again afterwards. Outside. At night. Not on the recording. I do not know if it is true. I am not willing to find out on your behalf.
### #8 treeline_patrol (OP) // 83.05.18 Security collected the camp and the recorder. They told me the two campers had most likely got lost and would walk out. The next day a man from the Company came and asked for my copy. I said I did not have one. He thanked me and asked whether I had heard anything on it. I said no. He asked whether anyone else had heard it. I said no.
He did not ask what was on it. He already knew.
### #9 ember_keeper (mod) // 83.05.21 A and B are on [netlink="lastseen.deep" link="lastseen.deep"] now. A's sister has been told. She has stopped calling her kid in from the door. She goes out and fetches him by the hand.
Locking this one. If you hear any of the lines above, from anywhere, you know what to do. Do not answer.
